instruction: Change the default font to Palatino Linotype in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font in LibreOffice Writer to Palatino Linotype. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu configuration file to verify the default font setting has been changed to 'Palatino Linotype'. This uses the existing find_default_font metric function.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if default font is set to Palatino Linotype, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks the LibreOffice config file (registrymodifications.xcu) for default font setting
Metric function find_default_font properly parses XML and extracts the Standard font from /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont path
Expected value 'Palatino Linotype' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: single requirement (change default font) is fully verified
Robust error handling: handles missing files and XML parsing errors gracefully
Semantic logic is correct: exact string comparison for font name is appropriate
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding a postconfig to close and reopen LibreOffice to ensure config changes are flushed to disk, though LibreOffice typically writes settings immediately so this may not be necessary
